ms.report:
A. Output: [What was delivered as Output A]
Completion of the final set of ledger validation rule implementations for the Amaru Ledger project, including implementation, review-driven refinements, merge, validation, and public reporting.
This milestone delivered the final one-third of the planned validation rule set, covering four of the eleven total identified rules:
・InvalidKeyWitness: MissingRequiredKeyWitnesses
・InvalidKeyWitness: InvalidSignatures
・InvalidBootstrapWitness: MissingRequiredBootstrapWitness
・InvalidBootstrapWitness

During pull request review and discussion, refinements were applied to rule logic, error handling, and structure — particularly around vkey witness and bootstrap witness validation and associated error cases. These adjustments were incorporated prior to merge to ensure correctness and alignment with the project’s validation framework.
This output therefore includes:
・Rule implementation
・Testing and log validation
・Review-driven refinements
・PR merge
・Maintainer confirmation
・Amaru team sign-off
・Public reporting and demonstration

Acceptance criteria: [Completion criteria for Output A]
・Final batch of GitHub pull requests for these validation rules submitted, reviewed, and merged.
・Reviewer and maintainer feedback addressed during the PR review process.
・Validation and confirmation of completed work provided by the Amaru team.
